status: W01 exploratory methods/data manuscript skeleton; not completed paper
results_boundary: Only explicitly identified completed v0.6 artifacts. Ongoing v0.7 scoring/backend outcomes intentionally excluded. v0.7 planning documents may support prospective study design.
citation_status: Ten references from the verified targeted primary-source review are cited. arXiv records remain preprints. Explicit remaining literature gaps are not claimed covered; no exhaustive novelty audit or reproduced external results.

claims.claim: Correction-dependent record reconstruction under uncertain factual interpretations and update targets is the working empirical question; prevalence and useful joint-inference benefit remain unmeasured.
claims.scope_and_caveat: No demonstrated natural-data joint-inference advantage or novelty claim.

claims.claim: Availability cutoff, event day and report time are separate; every declared dependency must be eligible.
claims.scope_and_caveat: Recorded dates and declared dependencies are not independently authenticated historical availability or protection against undeclared context.

claims.claim: One resolved/unresolved reading and one outgoing typed link/null are selected per mention; resolved claims preserve key, value and evidence.
claims.scope_and_caveat: Scope must encode single-valued distinctions. Structural validity is not source entailment.

claims.claim: Connected half-open integer-day episodes, equality links, ordered change links and exact conditional temporal-network projections are implemented.
claims.scope_and_caveat: No universal nonoverlap or forward persistence; no claims over alternative decoder assignments; classical solver novelty not asserted.

claims.claim: Whole-assertion corrections withdraw selected target support before temporal closure; correction-chain notices remain operative and essential dependencies propagate inactivity.
claims.scope_and_caveat: Authority/reference entailment is annotated, not mechanically proven; bare retraction, partial edits and correction-notice reversal unsupported.

claims.claim: Answers distinguish schedule versus actual state, preserve original report horizons, and track may/must support, conflict, indeterminacy and abstention.
claims.scope_and_caveat: Returned certainty is conditional on one selected interpretation; no uncertainty integration across plausible assignments.

claims.claim: Historical objective sums net reading, selected-link and null scores over the shared feasible space.
claims.scope_and_caveat: Numeric score objective is not calibrated probability or factual utility. Null scores are not beta scaled.

claims.claim: Independent maximizes net unaries and then exactly optimizes links; coordinate trials reoptimize all links; exact reference enumerates within shared limits.
claims.scope_and_caveat: Bounds are common engineering limits, not scalability evidence. Exact score optimality is not factual correctness.

claims.claim: Active-support objective anchors inactive terms to unresolved/null alternatives and can suppress a valid correction; existing frozen-score diagnostics observe suppression.
claims.scope_and_caveat: Ablation is not a successful proposed method; offset invariance is not scale/duplication invariance. Source replay is forecast-record correction with authored scores, not financial outcomes or natural accuracy.

claims.claim: Completed v0.6 pilot has 2 source records, 7 mentions, 7 resolved readings, 7 unresolved readings, 11 links and 32 unversioned ordinal judgments; all methods agree; 3 recodings preserve selections in 12 historical decodes.
claims.scope_and_caveat: One development history/prefix; one resolved reading per mention; recorded representation repair; unknown model revision; no QA gold, accuracy, candidate recall, calibrated probabilities, or pinned generation reproducibility.

claims.claim: The v0.6 objective audit records 23497 checks and zero mismatches in its finite domains.
claims.scope_and_caveat: Checks are not independent natural histories or model-evaluation samples. Verified only the implemented bounded score/state contracts.

claims.claim: Prospective primary evaluation uses controlled prefixes of frozen document versions, distinct delivery/retrieval/publication/event clocks, a target of twenty development histories, and separate routine/enriched slices. Historically faithful replay is a separately certified slice. Candidate proposal coverage differs from residual full-context ambiguity.
claims.scope_and_caveat: Frozen design only: zero histories completed under the new protocol. Existing cutoffs/results are not retroactively admitted. The sampling frame, annotation materials and executable collection pipeline remain future work. No v0.7 audit/scoring outcome is claimed in this draft.

claims.claim: Current representation/search limits and unresolved source, candidate, uncertainty and evaluation limitations preclude a paper-level empirical claim.
claims.scope_and_caveat: Limitations are specific to this checkpoint; do not imply they are fundamental impossibility results.

claims.claim: Temporal graph memory, multiple clocks, dynamic-fact evaluation, joint local-label/temporal-link inference, temporal constraint networks and truth maintenance have direct precedents. The narrower correction-dependent reconstruction question remains empirical and unproven; neither the controlled stream nor jointly selecting labels establishes novelty.
claims.scope_and_caveat: Targeted review of ten verified references, not exhaustive related work or a novelty certificate. No external experiment reproduced and no negative expressive-power claim about prior frameworks. arXiv entries are preprints. Modern entity/coreference, temporal database, belief revision and uncertainty-aware structured-prediction gaps remain explicitly open.
